committee: * Presentation of Certificate No. 336-38 (COR) - Senator Tina Rose Muña-Barnes
title: Buenas yan Håfa Adai! Please join me in presenting, Certificate No. 336-38 (COR) - Tina Rose Muña-Barnes – Presented to Guam Council of Women’s Clubs the officers and members on the celebration of Women’s History Month; and to commend them for their successful coordination of the Women’s Fair and Table Fashions Tea Show held on March 22, 2026, at the Micronesia Mall. Presentation will take place during the Guam Council of Women’s Clubs “Table Fashions Tea Show” event on Sunday, March 22, 2026 at 12pm at the Micronesia Mall Center Court. Si Yu’os Ma’åse’! 3/19/26 10:39 AM (FN)
